scope: Orvlet-owned browser players only; no operating-system media session or other application control.

cases.request: 另外开一个独立播放器听lofi

assertions: Natural desire requests trigger real YouTube search and playback.
Changing style keeps the same media task.
Explicitly additional player creates two distinct tasks with exactly one playing source.
Resuming the previous player pauses the new player before playing.

knownLimit: An earlier longer additional-player request timed out waiting for the configured model service. This does not establish universal latency or semantic routing accuracy.
implementation: Audio ownership is enforced separately from Jev/main-model routing.
Other players are held and their pauses awaited before releasing the next player.
A webpage design cannot adopt an unrelated task source.
Source-bound tools and design schemas are deferred until a page is owned.
